name: home-assistant
author: octos
description: Control and query a Home Assistant smart home via its REST API. Requires two environment variables: HA_URL (base URL incl. scheme/host/port, e.g. https://ha.example.com:8123 — do NOT include /api) and HA_TOKEN (a Home Assistant long-lived access token). Lets the agent read entity states, list entities by domain, and call services to control devices (lights, switches, climate, etc.).

tools.name: ha_get_states
tools.description: Read the current state of Home Assistant entities. With no argument returns all entities (capped). Pass an exact entity_id (e.g. 'light.kitchen') to fetch one, or any substring to filter entities by entity_id or friendly name (case-insensitive).

entity_id.description: Optional. An exact entity_id (e.g. 'light.kitchen') to fetch a single entity, OR a substring to filter entities by entity_id and friendly name.

tools.name: ha_call_service
tools.description: Call a Home Assistant service to control a device, e.g. domain 'light' service 'turn_on'. Target via entity_id and pass any extra service parameters in 'data' (e.g. brightness_pct, temperature). Returns the entities whose state changed.

entity_id.description: Target entity id or array of entity ids, e.g. 'light.kitchen'.

data.description: Optional extra service parameters merged into the request body, e.g. {"brightness_pct": 60, "color_name": "red"}.

tools.name: ha_list_entities
tools.description: List Home Assistant entities grouped by domain (the part before the first '.'), with a per-domain count and each entity's friendly name and state. Optionally filter to a single domain (e.g. 'light'). Good for a low-token overview of what's in the house.
